title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in April's chat, or tap **More info** on an item and paste the request there, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: Iran hits a **US radar station in Bahrain** with drones, its second attack on Bahrain in three days
items.summary_md: It ends a roughly two-month lull while US talks are stalled; the NYT reports the **USS Theodore Roosevelt** will soon make it **three US carriers** in the region.

items.headline_md: Update: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say **two more tankers** hit mines in the **Strait of Hormuz**, and one sank
items.summary_md: The IRGC says six tankers have caught fire in similar incidents over two days; the claims come via Iranian state media.

items.headline_md: Yemen's government forces pull back from the **Bab al-Mandab** strait as the **Houthis** advance
items.summary_md: Southern forces say they're redeploying to defend Aden; Saudi Arabia separately says it shot down Houthi drones over Mecca and Medina.

items.headline_md: **Estonia** will close all border crossings with **Russia** from **Dec 1**
items.summary_md: The foreign minister cited a failed sabotage attempt against an Estonian defense company.

items.headline_md: A **UPS cargo plane** and a **passenger jet** collided at **Miami International Airport** Saturday night
items.summary_md: Two people had minor injuries in the collision around 9:15 PM local time.

items.headline_md: Update: **Jensen Huang** has discussed **returning as Nvidia CEO**, the FT reports
items.summary_md: An open letter for his reinstatement has 165,000+ signatures, over 7,500 of them self-identified Nvidia staff; interim CEO Colette Kress presents earnings Tuesday.

items.headline_md: The **euro** falls to an **18-month low** just above **$1.10** as the dollar rallies
items.summary_md: Investors expect US rates to rise faster than eurozone rates because US inflation looks sticky.

items.headline_md: ECB vice president warns an **AI repricing** could cause big market losses
items.summary_md: Boris Vujcic said IPO volumes relative to US GDP are on track to top the dot-com peak, a pattern that often coincides with market tops.

items.headline_md: UK **2-year gilt yields** top **5%** for the first time since Feb 2024
items.summary_md: The Bank of England's chief economist, Huw Pill, signaled rate rises next month and in early 2027.

items.headline_md: **Tata Motors** shares drop **8.7%**, their worst day since Feb 2022, after cutting the **Jaguar Land Rover** margin outlook
items.summary_md: It now expects a 2–3% adjusted EBIT margin, down from 4%, after a quarterly net loss of about $588M.

items.headline_md: Gravity launches **RO Lite - Match**, a Ragnarok-themed **triple-tile matching** puzzle game, worldwide
items.summary_md: It's the third game in its RO Lite casual line (after Arrow and Block Puzzle), with felt-textured art, layered stages and boss stages.

items.headline_md: Bart Bonte's color puzzle **brown** arrives on iOS and Android **Tue Nov 17**
items.summary_md: It's the ninth game in his series: 50 levels, each with its own logic, and several hints per level.

items.headline_md: Water puzzle **Acequia** is out on iPhone and iPad: **no ads**, 13 free levels, then one purchase
items.summary_md: You tip clay pots to route water through 74 gardens; no sign-in is needed, and it's in 45 languages.

items.headline_md: **Playtika** ends its sale review and stays an **independent** public company
items.summary_md: The board decided independence offers the best long-term value for shareholders.

items.headline_md: **Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown** is coming to **Apple Arcade**
items.summary_md: It already has controller support, 60 FPS and accessibility options; this week's launches also include Transformers: Eternal War and Poppy Playtime Chapter 5.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo or release from the r/decomps user. GitHub searches turned up only single-game Wii U recomps (e.g., BOTW, Smash 4, MH3U, all from October), not a general lifter, and r/decomps was unreadable today (Reddit blocked it). Watch list: [Quiver Launcher 4.0.0-beta.6](https://github.com/tgeorgiadis/quiver-launcher/releases) (6:15 AM AZ Sunday) is still a beta, not 4.0.0 stable. Longshot, Recompia (0.13.9) and Boxshelf only shipped routine builds. No new NotRexed activity.

items.headline_md: PS5: **KytyPS5** can now upscale **PSSR** games with **AMD FSR**, and build **2026-11-15** is out
items.summary_md: Update since Nov 13: it already supported swapping PSSR for DLSS, and the project says 41% of PS5 system library functions are now in place.

items.headline_md: Switch 2: **RetroArch** (22 cores) and **Dolphin NX2** hit the **kaiHEN** homebrew environment
items.summary_md: Dolphin NX2 v1.0.0 (Nov 15) is a first test release that runs GameCube games like Mario Kart: Double Dash!!; you need kaiHEN, firmware 23.0.1 demos, and your own games.

items.headline_md: Arcade: **SM2-Emu** is now **Keisho** (0.9.60) and adds **Sega Model 3**
items.summary_md: 52 of 54 tested Model 3 sets reach gameplay, including Scud Race and Daytona USA 2, with linked multi-cabinet races over Wi-Fi.

items.headline_md: A dev added **rollback netplay** to **MAME** for up to **4-player** co-op arcade games
items.summary_md: Join with a 7-character room code, with no accounts or router setup; all 256 listed games were tested online on Linux, Steam Deck, Windows and Mac.

items.headline_md: **Ebenezer** did better abroad, for a **$42M** global opening
items.summary_md: Foreign audiences in 62 markets added $23M; the UK led, and it was No. 1 in Italy, Mexico and Spain. That's good enough on a net $38M budget, Deadline says.

items.headline_md: Audiences like **Ebenezer** more than critics do: **A-** CinemaScore and **90%** audience score vs **54%** from critics
items.summary_md: Its audience skews older (78% of over-55s would definitely recommend it), so Deadline expects it to hold through Thanksgiving.

items.headline_md: **How to Rob a Bank** looks set to lose money, Deadline says
items.summary_md: The David Leitch film cost a net $40M before marketing, and the Gen Z men it targeted were only 21% of the audience.

items.headline_md: **Ramayana** nears **$150M** worldwide; **Godzilla Minus Zero** passes **$100M**
items.summary_md: Ramayana is now the seventh-biggest Indian film ever, with India's biggest second weekend; Godzilla cost about $20M to make.

items.headline_md: Laika's **Wildwood** reaches **$70M** worldwide and should pass **Kubo** ($76.2M)
items.summary_md: France and other territories still haven't opened.

items.headline_md: Update: **The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** could open to **$100M** next weekend
items.summary_md: Deadline now floats $100M for the Nov 20 opening, up from the $80M+ tracking we noted yesterday, and expects a quiet pre-holiday weekend before it.

items.headline_md: AI is now the **Fed's** most-cited financial stability risk
items.summary_md: 87% of surveyed contacts flagged AI-related risks, up from 50% in May, pointing to complex AI financing, cyber threats and a possible correction.

items.headline_md: The **US and allies** agree to protect **critical AI supply chains** from China-linked weak points
items.summary_md: Countries including Japan and India will name sensitive technologies for joint protection, and US lawmakers are pushing tighter AI-chip export rules.

items.headline_md: Google's **Gemini 4 Carbon** takes first place on **MathArena**, ahead of **GPT-6.1 Sol**
items.summary_md: The tested setup cost about 15x more per evaluation and often ran past the time limit.

items.headline_md: **Disney** leans into AI with **Ozzy Fox**, an AI-assisted animated series coming to **Disney+** in December
items.summary_md: Its proposed $1B OpenAI partnership fell apart after Sora shut down.

items.headline_md: **Sierra's Poppy 1.0** tells AI shopping agents what each business allows, and **Shopify** turned it on store-wide
items.summary_md: More than 100 companies are taking part, and Meta's Muse checks for it automatically.

items.headline_md: Apple will stop accepting **On-Demand Resources** in **new apps** from **early 2027**
items.summary_md: Per the Nov 12 App Store Connect notes, apps that have never used ODR must switch to Background Assets; existing ODR apps keep working for now.

items.headline_md: Google Play now hosts private **vibe-coded** personal apps with **no developer account**, and adds **"Ask Play about this app"**
items.summary_md: You can now ask questions on any store listing before installing; a "Shop devices" link is also coming in select regions.

items.headline_md: Ads: the **AppLovin–Unity** fight over the **Ad Quality** SDK is still in arbitration, with no ruling yet
items.summary_md: AdBic suggests publishers using MAX or LevelPlay audit which ad SDKs and review tools run in their builds and watch Unity's bids inside MAX.

items.headline_md: ULA's **Vulcan** failed to put **40 Amazon Leo** internet satellites into orbit
items.summary_md: The rocket had an in-flight anomaly shortly after liftoff from Florida.

items.headline_md: A hack of La Poste's **Maileva** exposed data on about **22 million** people
items.summary_md: French media report the breach hit La Poste Group's digital mail subsidiary.

items.summary_md: Tech is leading the drop ahead of Nvidia's earnings Tuesday after the close and Anthropic's IPO pricing Wednesday.

items.headline_md: AI names slide premarket (5:13 AM AZ): **Nvidia ~$156.98 (≈−3.6%)**, **CoreWeave ≈−7.5%**, **Nebius ≈−7.4%**
items.summary_md: Changes are vs Friday's close; earlier, Asian chip and AI stocks fell, and the Kospi and TW50 slid.
Oil slipped even with the new Hormuz tanker reports.

items.headline_md: **Bitcoin ~$63,965** and **Ether ~$1,793**, both down about 2% since midnight UTC, at 5:12 AM AZ
items.summary_md: Bitcoin is about $1,300 below yesterday's 5 AM AZ reading.

items.headline_md: Japan's **Nikkei 225** closed **−2.4% at 59,662** (11:30 PM AZ Sunday) after weak Q3 GDP
items.summary_md: The dollar index is near 103.5, and the euro is at an 18-month low.

sections.title: Weather
sections.body_md:
No ice storm or tornado threat for the St. Louis area in the next 7 days, and no active NWS alerts for either point ([NWS alerts](https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=38.7875,-90.6299)). Update: yesterday's low-confidence severe-storm signal for Saturday is gone from today's [SPC Day 4–8 outlook](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/exper/day4-8/), and SPC Days 1–3 show no severe areas. NWS St. Louis expects dry, warming weather (upper 60s to low 70s Thu–Fri), then a cold front Sat Nov 21 with light rain at most: about a 60% chance of any rain but 30% or less for 0.10 in or more, and lows stay well above freezing all week ([NWS St. Louis discussion](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=LSX&issuedby=LSX&product=AFD)).

items.headline_md: **St. Peters**: sunny, high near **56°**, low around **35°** tonight, 0% rain chance
items.summary_md: Light south wind of 1–5 mph; patchy river-valley fog may linger until about 8–9 AM CT.

items.headline_md: **Berkeley**: sunny, high near **57°**, low around **37°** tonight, 0% rain chance
items.summary_md: Tuesday is sunny and 58°, and it warms to about 67° by Thursday.

items.headline_md: Wes Fenlon: **Ocarina of Time just proved every Nintendo game is a PC game now**
items.summary_md: A long, inside look at how AI-assisted coding is making Switch 2 forks and recomps like the OoT ones you follow appear at breakneck speed, and what that means for Nintendo.
